title: Protein Labeling with Incubation
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all consumables and equipment listed: NEST 96‑well PCR plate, NEST 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes, Opentrons 300 µL pipette tips, Opentrons 20 µL pipette tips, Opentrons Temperature Module with aluminum block, P300 single‑channel pipette, P20 single‑channel pipette, and any reagents required for the protein labeling reaction.

steps.title: Load samples into tube rack
steps.instruction: Place the selected sample tubes (1–19 tubes) into the 24‑well aluminum block that sits on the temperature module.

steps.title: Add reagents to each sample
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate labeling reagents to each sample tube as specified by the experimental design (exact reagents and volumes are defined elsewhere).

steps.title: Incubate samples at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to 37 °C and incubate the samples for up to four days.

steps.title: Aliquot 20 µL at time points
steps.instruction: At the 1‑day, 2‑day, and 4‑day marks, transfer 20 µL from each incubating sample to the destination plate; repeat this aliquoting up to three times (once at each time point).

steps.title: Prepare Opentrons deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, loading the PCR plate, tip racks, and any other required labware onto the appropriate slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the positions of all labware, tip racks, and both the P300 and P20 pipettes.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Start the protocol run in the OT App by pressing “Run”.
